stem: Meera tests a piece of dal (lentils) from her school lunch in the science lab. She adds copper sulphate solution and caustic soda solution to the food sample. Which observation shows that protein is present in the food?

options.text: A violet colour appears in the solution.
The solution stays pale blue with no change.
A white oily layer forms on the top.

teacher.key_rationale: In the protein test, a violet colour after adding copper sulphate solution and caustic soda solution indicates protein is present. Brick-red suggests a reducing sugar test result, no colour change means protein absent, and an oily layer relates to fat, not protein.
